item.title: Senators side with DOJ in fight for Georgia voter list with personal information
item.description: A Georgia Senate panel approved a resolution Thursday calling on Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger to turn over the state’s unredacted voter list to the U.S. Department of Justice — including voters’ Social Security and driver’s license numbers. The post Senators side with DOJ in fight for Georgia voter list with personal information appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Nine stabs, no answers: Inside the mysterious Augusta jail cell assault
item.description: A violent stabbing inside the Charles B. Webster Detention Center on Thursday left an inmate with nine stab wounds and five people facing felony charges, including the man accused in the fatal drive-by shooting of 8-year-old Arbrie Leigh Anthony. The post Nine stabs, no answers: Inside the mysterious Augusta jail cell assault appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta fire destroys vacant home on Chafee Avenue
item.description: A vacant house was destroyed by fire Saturday at 841 Chafee Ave. in Augusta, the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office said. The post Augusta fire destroys vacant home on Chafee Avenue appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Grovetown teacher Kalinda Redel nominated for national LifeChanger of the Year award
item.description: Grovetown Elementary School fifth-grade language arts teacher Kalinda Redel has been nominated for National Life Group’s 2025-26 LifeChanger of the Year award, a national program that recognizes K-12 educators and school district employees who make a difference in students’ lives through leadership and positive impact. The post Grovetown teacher Kalinda Redel nominated for national LifeChanger of the Year award appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta University, Augusta Tech to close on Monday
item.description: Augusta University and Augusta Tech will be closed on Monday, Jan. 26. The post Augusta University, Augusta Tech to close on Monday appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Local organizations hold event for inquiring community members about data center development
item.description: The ongoing controversy regarding data center development in the CSRA inspired local groups to organize a seminar for locals, Thursday night, particularly those inclined to oppose, to garner info and learn what they can do in response. The post Local organizations hold event for inquiring community members about data center development appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta elections board backs off most polling place changes
item.description: Most of the proposed polling place and precinct changes that would have uprooted thousands of Richmond County voters ahead of busy May elections are on hold. The post Augusta elections board backs off most polling place changes appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: RCSO works through severe weather to protect unhoused, at-risk residents
item.description: The Richmond County Sheriff’s Office spent hours Sunday conducting welfare checks and transporting vulnerable residents to shelter as freezing temperatures, rain and the threat of ice moved into the area.
